{{flagicon|PAR}} [[Richard Báez]] (10) | prevseason = [[Primera División Chilena 1996|1996]] | nextseason = [[Primera División Chilena 1998|1998]] }} The '''[[1997 in football (soccer)|1997 tournament]]''' of the '''[[Primera División de Chile]]''' was based in the typical [[Apertura and Clausura|Apertura-Clausura]] scheme used in many football leagues in Latin-America, similar to the [[Primera División Argentina|Argentinian First Division]]. For the first time, this format, with two champions, was used. This tournament format was dropped for the next season (1998), but came back, from 2002 to 2017. Both champions qualified for the [[1998 Copa Libertadores|Copa Libertadores]], while the two teams with fewest points overall relegated.
